item.title: The Real Cost of a Slow Batch Load: What Cutting 4 Minutes to 45 Seconds Actually Taught Me
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: 2026's data engineering conversation has shifted from \"can it scale\" to \"what does it cost to run.\" Here's the exact tuning work that took one ingestion pipeline from a 4-minute load to 45 seconds.

item.title: Why I'm Not Rushing to Put PesaGuard on Iceberg (Yet)
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: Iceberg Summit 2026 declared the adoption question settled. For a solo builder running one pilot customer on Postgres, the actual question is different: settled for who, and at what scale?

item.title: Why I'm Building PesaGuard on Event-Driven Architecture, Not Batch
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: Batch processing is no longer the center of gravity in 2026 data systems. Here is why Daraja and M-Pesa fraud detection requires instant stream ingestion over overnight batch jobs.

item.title: What 'Platform Engineering' Means for a Solo Data Engineer
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: The 2026 shift is moving away from tool-hoarding toward internal data platforms. How I apply modular platform thinking across CampusHub, MyChama, and PesaGuard.

item.title: Governance-as-Code for M-Pesa Data Pipelines
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: Automation-first compliance: enforcing automated audit trails, line-level data lineage, and Kenyan Data Protection Act requirements directly inside Git CI/CD.

item.title: AI Copilots Didn't Replace My Pipeline Work: They Changed What 'Junior' Means
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: AI tools draft SQL, write boilerplate connectors, and debug errors automatically. Where engineer judgment matters most in an AI-assisted world.
